property_summary: For every element i, the correct contract must make exactly one external call to caddress with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) carrying arguments (from, _tos[i], v[i]) in that order, so a recording token observes recipient[i] == _tos[i] and amount[i] == v[i]; the mutant swaps recipient and amount and violates this whenever they differ.
change_summary: Swap the recipient and amount arguments in the external call, sending the amount as the address and the recipient as the amount.
